summary: When a replacement name is withdrawn, the park using the old name still has a decision to make.
realLife: The Connecticut cave applicant withdrew after objections to naming it for a fictional character. Park management was considering alternatives for the name it used locally.
inGame: needs: the withdrawn proposal, the local name still in use and any subsequent park decision.

turns.writesBack: The park can continue its own review.

turns.what: The park director records that local decision.
turns.pulledBy: The park settles on another name.
